tldr: On Oct 16, coverage framed Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 as a name without a released model, and one report said a new Chinese export-license requirement for large AI models could affect it. On Oct 23, reports said it was being readied for release after Arena testing.
whats_new: On Oct 26, TradingView reported Moonshot AI reset Kimi K3.1 Pro quotas after user complaints, following the Oct 24 launch coverage of the Pro model.
why_it_matters: Quota resets after complaints signal usage limits on the new Pro tier are still unsettled, which affects capacity planning and reliability for anything routed to it.

status.detail: Kimi K3.1 Pro is now covered as launched, with a Pro Highspeed API reported, but Moonshot had to reset quotas after user complaints.

beats.headline: Kimi K3.1 discussed before any model ships; export-license rule flagged
beats.summary: Oct 16 items: a name-only comparison piece and a report on a Chinese export-license requirement for new large AI models.

beats.headline: Release prep after Arena testing, plus head-to-head comparison
beats.summary: Oct 23 items: release-readiness report and a comparison with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra.

beats.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro launches as a 3T-parameter flagship
beats.summary: Oct 24 items: SiliconANGLE launch report and a Latent Space issue citing open weights and a Pro Highspeed API.

beats.headline: Moonshot resets Pro quotas after user complaints
beats.summary: Oct 26 item: quota reset following complaints.

open_questions: Do independent evals confirm the Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra comparison claims?
Does the reported Chinese export-license requirement restrict Kimi K3.1 availability?
Does Moonshot publish a stable quota policy for Kimi K3.1 Pro after the reset?
take_for_builders: Rerun your own evals on Kimi K3.1 Pro before routing traffic, and keep a fallback model until Moonshot's quota limits and license terms are confirmed stable.
